scope: Profile the retained solvers and identify larger optimization targets; no production algorithm changes in this pass.

phaseDiagnostics.purpose: Separate worker readiness, reads, parsing, aggregation export and main-thread finish, including worker balance and thread CPU where available.
phaseDiagnostics.method: Instrument isolated copies, preserving exact complete output and original production source hashes. Treat durations as diagnostic, record instrumentation and overhead controls.

checks: Compare new hot regions with previous rejected experiments before proposing a target.
Do not infer hardware cache misses or branch misses from PC samples.
Record raw samples separately from interval weights and concurrent thread spans.
Check output and source stability for every capture.
Use unsigned commits for profiling experiments and conclusions.
